Dashboard.title: Testing Showcase
Dashboard.description: Welcome to the results dashboard. Here you will find a detailed report of the test suites applied to this project, ensuring the quality and reliability of the application.

formSuite.title: Form Integration Tests
formSuite.description: Verifies AuthForm renders and UI behaviors based on state.

test1.title: Base Inputs Render
test1.description: Confirms properly rendered email and password inputs.

test2.title: Hide Confirm Password
test2.description: Ensures the confirm password input is hidden from the login view.

test3.title: Forgot Password Action
test3.description: Verifies the presence of account recovery options.

signUpSuite.title: Sign Up Form Tests
signUpSuite.description: Verifies AuthForm correctly adapts its interface for registering new users.

test1.title: Render Confirm Password
test1.description: Checks if the confirm password input is visible in sign-up mode.

test2.title: Hide Forgot Password
test2.description: Ensures the forgot password button is hidden during sign-up.

uiInteractiveSuite.title: UI Interactivity Tests
uiInteractiveSuite.description: Checks interactive elements like toggling visibility and CTA navigation.

test1.title: Toggle Password Visibility
test1.description: Verifies that clicking the eye icon reveals and hides the password.

test2.title: CTA Navigation
test2.description: Ensures clicking 'create an account' triggers page navigation.

zodSubmissionSuite.title: Zod Validation & Submission
zodSubmissionSuite.description: Validates form submissions and Zod error handling.

test1.title: Display Zod Errors
test1.description: Confirms error messages display when submitting invalid payloads.

emailSchemaSuite.title: Email Validation Tests
emailSchemaSuite.description: Verifies the rules and constraints applied to email inputs.

test1.title: Approve Valid Email
test1.description: Ensures properly formatted emails are accepted.

test3.title: Reject Empty Email
test3.description: Triggers 'minEmailError' when the field is totally empty.

test4.title: Trim Whitespaces
test4.description: Ensures leading and trailing spaces are removed automatically.

passwordSchemaSuite.title: Password Validation Tests
passwordSchemaSuite.description: Verifies all security constraints required for passwords.

test1.title: Approve Valid Password
test1.description: Ensures strong, correctly formatted passwords pass validation.

test2.title: Reject Short Password
test2.description: Triggers 'minPasswordError' if the length is insufficient.

test4.title: Require Uppercase
test4.description: Triggers 'mustContainUppercase' if no capital letters are found.

test5.title: Require Lowercase
test5.description: Triggers 'mustContainLowercase' if no lowercase letters are found.

test6.title: Require Number
test6.description: Triggers 'mustContainNumber' if no digits are included.

signInSchemaSuite.title: Sign In Flow Tests
signInSchemaSuite.description: Verifies combined payload validation for existing users.

test1.title: Valid Payload
test1.description: Checks if the schema approves properly formatted credentials.

test2.title: Accumulate Errors
test2.description: Ensures multiple validation issues are caught simultaneously.

signUpSchemaSuite.title: Sign Up Flow Tests
signUpSchemaSuite.description: Verifies account creation payload and confirm-password constraints.

test1.title: Valid Payload
test1.description: Checks if an ideal registration schema with matching passwords passes.
